title: The Great AI Infrastructure Land Grab
description:
Is the consolidation of AI infrastructure—from Nvidia’s $13B Hugging Face acquisition to Google’s exclusive cyber-defense tools—a necessary stabilization of the industry or a dangerous enclosure of the digital commons?

What we covered:
• Google launches Fairwind Program for trusted partners to use advanced AI cyber defense tools
• New York City public schools temporarily ban generative AI for students through 8th grade
• Trump administration backs OpenAI in New York Times copyright lawsuit over training data
• Nvidia says it will spend $13 billion on Hugging Face in major AI infrastructure move
• EPA proposal could make public comment harder on proposed AI data centers

Tomorrow tension: Tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

A hard human debate about the top AI events of the day: who wins, who is exposed, and what changes tomorrow.
